    Teaching

    The group contributes to the following modules of the Biology and Computational Sciences programmes at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz.

    Winter semester

    • Modul 18 a/b/c — Molecular simulation and machine learning in molecular biology
    • Modul 16-2 — Chromatin Biology & Proteomics (Prof. Dr. P. Beli)
      • Lecture: Chromatin regulation by liquid-liquid phase separation
      • Research internships and projects on molecular simulations and machine learning are available in our lab as part of this module

    Summer semester

    • Modul 14 b — Polymer concepts in cellular function
      • Research internships and projects are available in our lab as part of the b part of the module
